language_samples.source: 《玩偶之家》，英文通行译本（挪威原文大意）。中文大意：我相信，我首先是一个有理智的人，和你一样——至少，我必须努力成为这样的人。
language_samples.text: I believe that before all else I am a reasonable human being, just as you are — or, at all events, that I must try to become one.

language_samples.source: 《玩偶之家》，英文通行译本（挪威原文大意）。中文大意：我一直是你的玩偶妻子，就像在家时我是爸爸的玩偶女儿一样。
language_samples.text: I have been your doll-wife, just as at home I was papa's doll-child.
